text: My most memorable trip was to Japan. I spent months planning the itinerary, researching trains and booking small, family-run hotels. The moment I arrived, I was overwhelmed by the culture—the quiet order of the streets and the polite bowing were so different from home. Trying the food was an adventure in itself; I loved the fresh sushi but struggled with the chewy texture of octopus. Language was a real barrier, and I often relied on hand gestures and a translation app. Still, despite the confusion, the kindness of strangers and the beautiful temples created lasting memories I will always treasure.
